name: Minnesota Open 2009
information: Even if you choose to pay the day of the competition, you still need to pre-register. Registration closes on July 5th. After that, you may be limited to the number of events you can register for.  If you pay the fees online, the cost will be $3 for the first event, and $1 for each additional event. If you pay the day of the competition, the cost is $5 for the first event, and $2 for each additional event. The fees go towards the cost of running the competition, prizes, etc. Any funds beyond that go towards future competitions.
